newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June T-bond futures end sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June T-bond futures end sharply lower.

text.p: April 4 - U.S. June T-bond futures ended sharply lower as a "sell-the-bounces" mentality ruled in the wake of March jobs data, trader said. June slid to another 7-month low but fell short of breaching 106-22/32 support from Sept 19. "It's just a slow grind lower, nothing has changed here," a bond options trader said.
